original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM Role for EC2 instances with permissions to write CloudWatch Logs and read SSM Parameter Store configuration

Parameters:
  RoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ec2-logs-config-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,64}$'

  LogGroupPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/ec2
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group prefix that this role can write to

  ParameterStorePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /app
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix this role can read

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment

Resources:
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref RoleName
      Description: Role allowing EC2 instances to write CloudWatch Logs and read SSM Parameter Store
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EC2-Logs-Config-Access

  CloudWatchLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${RoleName}-cloudwatch-logs'
      Description: Allows writing logs to CloudWatch Logs
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreateLogGroupsAndStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*'
          - Sid: PutLogEvents
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*'

  ParameterStorePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${RoleName}-parameter-store'
      Description: Allows reading configuration from SSM Parameter Store
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePrefix}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePrefix}'
          - Sid: DescribeParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DecryptSecureStringParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RoleName}-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RoleArn'

  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM Role
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RoleName'

  InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Instance Profile
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceProfileArn'

  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the EC2 Instance Profile
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
    Export:
